answers.core: This proposal is about changing a default project setting.
answers.workaround: Yes, since the **Allow Hidpi** project setting already exists. However, the current default provides a bad experience not only for game developers, but also for their players who just want to play fullscreen games in peace :slightly_smiling_face:

title: Enable "Allow Hidpi" by default to fix window management issues across platforms on hiDPI monitors
